name: [Brunn] Public edge connectivity
message: A public Brunn health or API-readiness endpoint failed from the Railway Datadog Agent. These probes resolve the public domain and traverse Railway's public edge; use the instance and URL tags to distinguish edge-to-web from edge-to-API failure before retrying writes.__NOTIFY__

name: [Brunn] Public edge response is slow
message: A public Brunn health or API-readiness endpoint exceeded the one-second response-time gate from the Railway Datadog Agent. Correlate the instance and URL tags with web, API, database, and Railway edge telemetry.__NOTIFY__

name: [Brunn] API heartbeat missing
message: The Brunn API has stopped reporting its runtime heartbeat. Check deployment health, container state, and dependency readiness.__NOTIFY__

name: [Brunn] Worker heartbeat missing
message: The Brunn worker has stopped reporting its runtime heartbeat. Durable jobs may no longer be advancing.__NOTIFY__

name: [Brunn] HTTP 5xx responses
message: Brunn returned server errors. Correlate request IDs with structured API logs before retrying writes.__NOTIFY__

name: [Brunn] Canonical dependency unavailable
message: A canonical Brunn dependency is unavailable. Readiness should be failing closed for the affected dependency.__NOTIFY__

name: [Brunn] Database pool saturation
message: A Brunn database pool is near saturation. Inspect in-flight requests and database latency before changing pool sizes.__NOTIFY__

name: [Brunn] Durable queue stalled
message: A durable Brunn queue has old unfinished work. Inspect queue state, worker leases, and bounded retry status.__NOTIFY__

name: [Brunn] Model request degraded
query: sum(last_10m):sum:brunn.model.requests{env:__DD_ENV__ AND service:__DD_SERVICE__ AND status IN (degraded_unavailable,invalid_output)} by {purpose,model,status}.as_count() >= 1
message: A capture or dreaming model request degraded or returned invalid structured output. Canonical writes must remain gated.__NOTIFY__

name: [Brunn] Embedding request failures
message: Embedding requests are failing. Inspect provider status and indexing backlog; do not silently switch embedding semantics.__NOTIFY__

name: [Brunn] Object integrity failure
message: Stored bytes did not match their committed hash. Treat this as a data-integrity incident and preserve the evidence.__NOTIFY__

name: [Brunn] Telemetry snapshot failure
message: Brunn cannot collect an operational snapshot. Runtime behavior may still be healthy, but observability is incomplete.__NOTIFY__

name: [Brunn] DogStatsD packets dropped
message: The Brunn metrics exporter dropped DogStatsD packets. Operational telemetry is incomplete.__NOTIFY__

name: [Brunn] Simplified workspace open is slow
message: Simplified workspace open p95 exceeded the documented five-second performance gate. Inspect workspace route latency, retrieval lane timeouts, database pool pressure, and deployment version.__NOTIFY__

name: [Brunn] Simplified retrieval lanes repeatedly timed out
message: A simplified retrieval lane repeatedly exceeded its bounded deadline. Inspect the affected lane and workspace search route latency. A single timeout warns for visibility; three in ten minutes is critical.__NOTIFY__

name: [Brunn] Simplified workspace search is slow
message: Workspace search p95 exceeded the documented three-second performance gate. This catches broad-query regressions even when individual retrieval lanes eventually return.__NOTIFY__

name: [Brunn] Simplified jobs repeatedly retrying
message: A simplified workspace job kind is repeatedly returning to retry. Inspect worker logs, embedding or model dependencies, and job duration before increasing retry limits. This metric does not distinguish the terminal fifth failure.__NOTIFY__
